نتقاضى (form VI)
# نَتَقَاضَى (nataqāḍā) /na.ta.qaː.dˤaː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
# نُتَقَاضَى (nutaqāḍā) /nu.ta.qaː.dˤaː/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
